A '''task force''' served as part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[Task force/Legends|task force]] was assigned to the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the remote [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]], an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that was under the rule of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. The task force arrived in the [[Kal'Shebbol system/Legends|Kal'Shebbol system]] at a specific [[Time/Legends|time]], which allowed a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] carrying elements of [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]] to infiltrate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the intention of bringing down the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]]. The task force battled [[Moff Sarne's forces|Sarne's forces]] in orbit, but were unable to prevent the Moff from escaping the planet in the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Ambition]]''. However, despite this setback, Page's [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]] were successful in lowering the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], allowing the New Republic to take Kal'Shebbol.

After the liberation, the task force was given three days to assist in securing the planet before it was to head to the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], hook up with [[Sarin Virgilio]] and his unit, and proceed to the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] to counter an Imperial official that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] was trying to box in. Because of these assignments, the [[Unidentified New Republic admiral|Admiral]] in command could not afford to commit a large amount of manpower or equipment to a mission that had been planned to hunt down Sarne. However, he did release as much personnel and supplies as was possible.

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Task force/Legends|task force]] was part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], it was assigned to liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]],<ref name="TSB" /> the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TDC" /> Since the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[4 ABY/Legends|four years earlier]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> the sector had been ruled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] as a breakaway [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] empire. As part of its campaign to deal with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] warlords that had sprung up in the wake of the Empire's destabilization, along with rumors that Sarne was in possession of advanced [[DarkStryder technology|alien technology]], the New Republic chose to end Moff Sarne's rule.<ref name="TSB" />

Commanded by an [[Unidentified New Republic admiral|admiral]], the task force entered the [[Kal'Shebbol system/Legends|Kal'Shebbol system]] at a pre-arranged [[Time/Legends|time]] and place. As part of the battle plan, an unmarked civilian [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] [[720 light freighter/Legends|Class 720 freighter]] carrying elements of the elite [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]], led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], had entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]] prior to the task force's arrival. Using the confusion of the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|assault]] as cover, Page's [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]] were to infiltrate [[Imperial Government Complex|Moff Sarne's headquarters]] and lower the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]]. The task force engaged [[Moff Sarne's forces]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="TSB" />

While the task force fought with Sarne's [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in orbit, the Moff himself managed to escape the planet in the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Ambition]]''. While Page's Commandos were successful in taking down the shields, Sarne marshaled his forces and disengaged from battle with the New Republic task force, managing to escape without revealing his [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] exit vector. With the shields down and Sarne's forces in retreat, the liberation of the planet began.<ref name="TSB" />

With Kal'Shebbol in New Republic hands, a mission was planned to follow Sarne into the Kathol sector. However, the task force had orders to leave Kal'Shebbol in three days to rendezvous with a force under the command of New Republic officer [[Sarin Virgilio]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], [[Supreme Commander]] of the New Republic Defense Force, was trying to deal with a rogue Imperial causing trouble in the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]], and needed forces to deal with him. Lieutenant Page, the planner of the mission to track down Sarne, wanted the Admiral in command of the task force to release a ship from his command to undertake the mission, but the Admiral refused. He did inform the Lieutenant that if Page could find a ship and a crew to undertake the mission, then he would release as much personnel and supplies as he was able to assist the mission.<ref name="TSB" /> When Page found a modified [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] that Sarne had abandoned in his retreat, the Admiral honored his word, transferring personnel&mdash;including [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Ranna Gorjaye]], [[Dasha Defano]], and [[Noell Ciro]],<ref name="TDC" /> navy [[Petty Officer/Legends|Petty Officer]] [[Colton (FarStar crewmember)|Colton]],<ref name="TIOM">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Traitor in our Midst|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> and Page's Commandos support operative [[T'achak T'andar]]&mdash;and starfighters to the corvette, which had been christened as the ''[[FarStar]]''.<ref name="TDC" /> Shortly after transferring the needed personnel and supplies to the ship, the task force departed for the Minos Cluster.<ref name="O">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Omens|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref>

==Organization==
The task force was comprised of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and starfighters with enough strength to defeat the forces of Moff Sarne and capture the planet Kal'Shebbol, provided that the planetary shields had been disabled beforehand. The task force was commanded by an admiral,<ref name="TSB" /> and the task force included pilots and support personnel for Page's Commandos.<ref name="TDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The task force was first mentioned in ''[[The Saga Begins]]'', a short story written by [[Timothy Zahn]] that served as the lead-in to ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', which was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].
